summary.name: Grok
summary.one_liner: Grok is an AI assistant from xAI (the page says "SpaceXSI") for chatting, image creation, coding, and real-time answers drawn from the web and X.
use_cases: getting real-time answers from the web
getting answers about posts on X
summary.what_it_does: The page describes Grok as an AI assistant that supports chat, image creation, code writing, and real-time answers from the web and X. The main chat interface is listed as available on web, iOS, and Android, and it is also integrated into X. The page text is mostly cookie consent content, so it gives no details on model versions, features beyond those listed, or specific limits.
notable: Real-time answers drawn from the web and X
Integrated into the X social platform
Image creation and code writing in one chat interface
